title: Abu Dhabi Investcorp Capital's FY 2026 net profit plummets
summary: Revenue from underwriting activities was down 17% on year
thbAction: Map the news to THB's provider CRM for referral growth, patient lifecycle engagement, and multi-facility relationship management across hospital and provider networks.
contentHtml:
Investcorp Capital's board has recommended a final dividend of $0.025 per share Image courtesy:Reuters Images

Revenue from underwriting activities was down 17% on year

Staff Writer ,  ZAWYA

Investcorp Capital (ICAP), an Abu Dhabi-listed asset manager, has posted FY 2026 net profit of $44 million, down 46% compared to FY 2025.
